failure_modes: If a temporal_teacher_blend or temporal_region_index edit were applied on the basis of the inspected sign-changing landmark contrasts, the unvalidated time-conditioned rule could displace surrounding coordinates without affinity benefit, since the whole-window z-values are small and mixed in sign and no decoded terminal labels confirm final affinity gain.

If pointcloud_delta_A were changed (C001-C003) without an absolute affinity label or decoded terminal outcome, the endpoint matching scale would shift the reward geometry while the primary affinity objective remains unmeasured, risking unnecessary coordinate displacement with no demonstrated advantage.

If teacher_neighbors were changed (C005-C007), the detached nearest-k teacher prior would be altered without evidence that the current k=4 is suboptimal for final affinity, since only coordinate contrast diagnostics were read.

Interpreting the large first/last rate z-values as a monotone coordinate reward direction would be a failure mechanism: these are endpoint-coordinate contrasts, not physical interaction energies or trajectory velocity forces, and the whole-window statistics do not support a consistent direction.
rationale: Affinity-first priority: the incumbent already encodes the declared objective (final predicted target affinity primary, validity/strain secondary, coordinate control only) with the endpoint-pointcloud reward view and detached FLOWR endpoint VJP, and no affinity-head derivative or extra model forward is available as evidence. The only registered edits are pointcloud_delta_A (C001-C003), region_index (C004), teacher_neighbors (C005-C007), temporal_region_index (C008) and temporal_teacher_blend (C009-C011). The inspected continuous_trends rows are coordinate features of the predicted endpoint world representation, not physical interaction energies or trajectory velocities; their first/last rate z-values are large but whole-window z-values are small and mixed in sign, with 4-10 sign changes and 1-9 strong sign conflicts, so no monotone coordinate reward direction is established and no time-conditioned rule is validated against a constant rule (H001). The observed window is [0.0,0.5] with curve support [0.0,0.49], recorded affinities removed and an equal score prior, so no absolute affinity label is present to justify a delta, neighbor-count or blend change. Because no decoded terminal labels or outcome data are supplied, selection enrichment cannot be equated with final affinity benefit (H002), and the evidence does not provide a defensible expected advantage for any offered edit over the incumbent. Retaining the incumbent is therefore the evidence-supported choice; deferring is unnecessary since the incumbent is a valid registered configuration.
